captures.stdout:
Discover capabilities advertised by project agents

Usage: buzz agents capabilities --project-address <PROJECT_ADDRESS>

Options:
      --project-address <PROJECT_ADDRESS>  Exact NIP-33 project address (`30621:<pubkey>:<d>`)
  -h, --help                               Print help

Submit a kind 43001 request from a strict JSON document

Usage: buzz jobs submit --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --input <INPUT>  JSON file, or '-' for stdin
  -h, --help           Print help

List durable job projections visible after reconnect

Usage: buzz jobs list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --project-address <PROJECT_ADDRESS>  Filter by exact NIP-33 project address
      --recipient <RECIPIENT>              Filter by addressee pubkey, or 'self'
      --state <STATE>                      Filter by projected lifecycle state
      --cursor <CURSOR>                    Opaque cursor returned by an earlier list
  -h, --help                               Print help

Get one durable operation projection

Usage: buzz jobs get --operation-id <OPERATION_ID>

Options:
      --operation-id <OPERATION_ID>  Canonical operation UUID
  -h, --help                         Print help

Publish a processed or accepted kind 43002 receipt

Usage: buzz jobs accept --operation-id <OPERATION_ID> --input <INPUT>

Options:
      --operation-id <OPERATION_ID>  Canonical operation UUID (must match the JSON body)
      --input <INPUT>                JSON file, or '-' for stdin
  -h, --help                         Print help
